rationale_evidence.anchor: Evidence provenance becomes causal structure ... e_j\prec e_i ... Dependency\Rightarrow NonIndependent ... NonIndependent \not\Rightarrow DirectDependency ... Two sources can share a common ancestor without one directly producing the other.
rationale_evidence.statement: Defines e_j≺e_i ('e_i was produced using e_j') and states the conservative rule Dependency⇒NonIndependent, while noting the converse fails: NonIndependent does not imply DirectDependency, because two sources can share a common ancestor without one producing the other directly.

rationale_evidence.anchor: A provisional theorem ... Evidence multiplicity is not equivalent to evidential independence. ... |E| \neq |\text{IndependentContributions}(E)| ... InformationVolume\neq EvidenceStrength ... Ten documents copied from one source do not necessarily provide ten pieces of evidence.
rationale_evidence.statement: States a provisional theorem that evidence multiplicity is not equivalent to evidential independence, formalized as |E| ≠ |IndependentContributions(E)| and InformationVolume ≠ EvidenceStrength, illustrated by ten documents copied from one source not necessarily providing ten pieces of evidence; called 'a very important KnowledgeOS principle'.

## Rationale
Defines e_j≺e_i ('e_i was produced using e_j') and states the conservative rule Dependency⇒NonIndependent, while noting the converse fails: NonIndependent does not imply DirectDependency, because two sources can share a common ancestor without one producing the other directly. [S0854] States a provisional theorem that evidence multiplicity is not equivalent to evidential independence, formalized as |E| ≠ |IndependentContributions(E)| and InformationVolume ≠ EvidenceStrength, illustrated by ten documents copied from one source not necessarily providing ten pieces of evidence; called 'a very important KnowledgeOS principle'. [S0854]

(anchor: "Identity ... e_1=e_2 ... This is a data/infrastructure property. ... Equivalence ... e_1\sim e_2 ... Independence ... e_1\perp e_2 ... Equivalence\neq\text{Independence}")

(anchor: "Dependency is actually richer than equivalence ... Database → LLM → Architecture report → Human summary ... e_1\rightarrow e_2\rightarrow e_3\rightarrow e_4 ...
